alerts.name: Cross Site Scripting (Reflected)
alerts.desc: Cross-site Scripting (XSS) is an attack technique that involves echoing attacker-supplied code into a user's browser instance.
alerts.solution: Validate all input and encode output based on context.

alerts.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.desc: Content Security Policy (CSP) is an added layer of security that helps to detect and mitigate certain types of attacks.
alerts.solution: Configure the web server to return the Content-Security-Policy header.

alerts.name: Missing Anti-clickjacking Header
alerts.desc: The response does not protect against 'ClickJacking' attacks.

alerts.name: Vulnerable JS Library
alerts.desc: The identified library appears to be vulnerable.
alerts.solution: Upgrade to the latest version of the affected library.

alerts.name: Cookie Without Secure Flag
alerts.desc: A cookie has been set without the secure flag.
alerts.solution: Set the secure flag on cookies containing sensitive information.

alerts.name: Server Leaks Version Information via "Server" HTTP Response Header Field
alerts.desc: The web server is leaking version information via the Server response header.
alerts.solution: Suppress the Server header or remove version details.

alerts.name: Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments
alerts.desc: The response appears to contain suspicious comments.
alerts.solution: Remove comments that return information that may help an attacker.
